clayPackages.name: Wheel-Throwing
clayPackages.description: Everyone throws functional pieces at the wheel: bowls, mugs, vases. A wheel-throwing "olympics" and group-throwing options are included at no extra cost.

clayPackages.name: Hand-Building
clayPackages.description: Slab-built mugs, coasters, and planters, with room for the group to design freely.

clayPackages.name: Wheel-Throwing & Hand-Building
clayPackages.description: Both techniques in one session, for groups that want a mix of functional and sculptural work.

clayPackages.name: Corporate Creativity & Connection
clayPackages.description: A longer session built for teams that want to slow down and co-create together.

woodworkingPackages.name: Serving Boards
woodworkingPackages.description: No experience required. Max 16 participants. Alcohol is restricted during this event.

woodworkingPackages.name: Muddler Making
woodworkingPackages.description: An introduction to spindle-turning fundamentals. Max 6 participants; alcohol restricted during the event.
